test_title: PYST 138: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 30 Jan,, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify and correct the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

The flora and fauna of the Anaimalai hills are uneeque to its region.
solution: The correct answer is **"unique."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"unique."** • It means one-of-a-kind or rare. (जिसके समान दूसरा नहीं, अनन्‍य, अद्वितीय, बेजोड़; अपनी तरह का अकेला, एकल) • **Example**: *Her style is very **unique**__.* • The incorrect spelling **"uneeque"** is missing the letter** "i."** • The sentence should read: *"The flora and fauna of the Anaimalai hills are __**unique**__ to its region."* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (fona)** is a misspelling of the word **"fauna."** • **Fauna: **all the animals of an area or a period of time. (काल-विशेष या क्षेत्र विशेष के जीव-जंतु) • **Option 3 (flaura)** is a misspelling of the word **"flora."** • **Flora: **all the plants growing in a particular area. (क्षेत्र-विशेष में उगने वाले सब पेड़-पौधे) • **Option 4 (regian)** is a misspelling of the word **"region."** • **Region: **a part of the country or the world; a large area of land. (देश या विश्‍व का कोई भाग, क्षेत्र; (ज़मीन का) कोई बड़ा इलाक़ा) 2f:T561, The correct answer is **"To require something."**
